content.name: Investment of the Chain Master
entries: When you cast {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52}, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

entries.name: Aerial or Aquatic
entries: The familiar gains either a Fly Speed or a Swim Speed (your choice) of 40 feet.

entries.name: Quick Attack
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can command the familiar to take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action.

entries.name: Necrotic or Radiant Damage
entries: Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

entries.name: Your Save DC
entries: If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: When the familiar takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to grant it {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} against that damage.
